articleTitle: Application of the sorption-frequency method in comparison with other methods for measurement of humidity nanoconcentrations in gases and liquids
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The article considers the sorption-frequency method (SFM) for measurement of gases and liquids humidity in comparison with other methods, which are widely applicable today. These methods are shortly described with their advantages and disadvantages. The conclusion about possibility or impossibility to apply each method for measurement of moisture nanoconcentrations is made. In the end of the article the results of comparing of various methods with SFM are presented in the context of possibility to apply them for measurement of moisture nanoconcentration in gases and liquids.

articleTitle: Automated information measurement system for determination of mechanical characteristics for polymer composite materials by longitudinal bending
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The article describes how to develop the automated information measurement system aimed at determination of mechanical characteristics for polymeric composite materials by longitudinal bending for quality control of serial production.

articleTitle: Self-aligned multilayer dielectric “dummy gate” technology for L-, S- and X-band GaAs MMICs fabrication
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the main aspects of the technology for GaAs microwave monolithic integrated circuits fabrication. The self-aligned technology with multilayer dielectric “dummy gate” used for fabrication of the metal-semiconductor field effect transistor with 0.5 microns gate length and ion implantation for channel, drain and source regions formation is described. Methods of front- and backside processing and specifications of control MMICs such as L-, S- and X-band switches, attenuators and phase-shifters are described.

articleTitle: Integral circuits of voltage control limiters
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: A new circuit of voltage control limiter based on PIN diodes has been developed. It was experimentally shown that we can decrease leakage power level to 10 mW.

articleTitle: Optical anisotropy in research of nanolayers
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The study is aimed at solving the problem associated with simultaneous determination of reflective index and dielectric film thickness in the thickness range of less than 40 nm. This problem has arisen from the needs of the modern nanoelectronics. The article discusses the ways to solve this problem on the basis of optically anisotropic crystals with their unique properties. It is hypothesized that decrease in reflective index with decreasing film thickness is a fundamental phenomenon. This hypothesis is based on the analysis of data obtained from full-scale experiments with SiO2 samples.

articleTitle: Core level X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy of RbTiOPO4 and chemical bonding in KTiOPO4, crystal family
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: • XPS method enables to analyze parameters of chemical bonds in complex dielectric oxides. • Difference of energies of photoelectric yield from 0 1s level and cation level is the most reproducible parameter. • Ranges of electronic parameters have been found for core levels of KTiOPO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> crystals. • Relations of yield energy difference to mean chemical bond length L(M-O) are specific for different-type cations. • Electronic parameters of complex oxides can be predicted on the basis of their structural characteristics. • Diagrams ΔBE — L(M-O) can be applied to screening of invalid XPS measurements.

articleTitle: Effect of substrate and doping profile parameters on characteristics of ion-implanted Schottky-barrier field-effect transistor (MESFET)
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: Application fields of GaAs field transistors: █ Cellular telephony █ High-speed fiber-optics data transfer █ Digital TV █ Wireless data transfer systems █ Radiolocation █ Satellite communication Requirements for transistors applied in these areas: █ High frequency (more than 3 GHz) █ High output power (more than 0.5 W/mm)

articleTitle: How to enhance Raman Scattering (RS) by nanoclusters: Desires and opportunities
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: • Observation of SERS generated by optical phonons in CdS quantum dots by surface phonons in ZnO • For CdS QD amplification factor reaches 730. • Double resonance conditions are observed • SERS is selective in relation to quantum dot size quantum number of localized modes

articleTitle: Acentric phase formation in AgLnX2 (Ln = Dy, Ho, Er; X = S, Se, Te) compounds
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: Available information on polymorph modifications observed for AgLnX<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> (Ln = Dy, Ho, Er; X = S, Se, Te) compounds has been analyzed comparatively. Cubic poly-morph with mixed (0.5Ag + 0.5Ln) cation positions is generally formed at high temperatures. Formation of monoclinic, orthorhombic and tetragonal acentric crystals is found at low temperature depending on the anion type.

articleTitle: Surface structure and optical properties of nanostructured Y2O3 films
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: Nanostructured Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films with an average crystallite-size ranging from 5 to 40 nm were grown by sputter-deposition onto Si(100) substrates. The surface structure and optical properties of Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films were evaluated. The size-effects were significant on the optical constants and their dispersion profiles of Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> films.

articleTitle: Inverse magnetoelectric effect in ferrite-piezoelectric composites
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The present work focuses on investigation of inverse magnetoelectric effect in the samples of ferrite-piezoelectric composites. Calculations are based on effective parameter method, in which composite is defined as a homogeneous medium. The dependence of inverse magnetoe-lectric effect has been found for the structures of ferrite-piezoelectric composite in the form of a plate and in the form of a disk.

articleTitle: Influence of substrate and doping profile parameters on characteristics of ion-implanted GaAs Schottky-barrier field-effect transistor (MESFET)
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: Ion-implanted GaAs MESFET was modeled and dependences of MESFET characteristics on doping profile parameters were found. These dependences allow to optimize transistor for different applications (power, high frequency or low-noise transistors).

articleTitle: High-speed driver for pin diode microwave switch
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: This article discusses the design of high-speed driver for PIN-diode microwave switches. The driver is built on a normally open pHEMT and controlled with TTL level signals.

articleTitle: Acentric phase formation in AgLnX, (Ln = Dy, Ho, Er; X = S, Se, Te) compounds
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: • AgLnX<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> compounds for heavy lanthanides crystallize in several structural types depending upon temperature and anion type. • At high temperatures AgLnX<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, compounds form the cubic structure with disordered cations. • Phase diagrams are observed for AgHoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and AgDySe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Wide homogeneity ranges are observed for binary compounds. • Crystal-chemical regularities of acentric phase formation are clear only in general terms. Crystal structures are known only for certain compounds. • Physical properties, including magnetic ones, have been almost not studied.

articleTitle: High-speed lasers and single-photon emitters with vertical cavities
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: □ Semiconductor vertical-cavity lasers (VCL) having high speed and possibility to be integrated in large-scale matrices are an ideal emitter for optical systems of parallel data transmission at date rate of 10 Gbps and higher (per channel). Application of VCL in matrix design opens broad opportunities for development of optical information system with speed of 1 Tbps order. □ High-efficient single-photon emitters (SPE) with current pumping based on semiconductor quantum dots and Bragg vertical microcavities may be of great interest for quantum cryptography systems and quantum calculations, as well as for development of hig h-precision spectrum equipment and optical power standards. This type of SPE may provide data rate of 1 Gbps and higher.

articleTitle: Core level spectroscopy of RbTiOPO4 and chemical bonding in KTiOPO4 crystal family
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: Valence band structure and electronic parameters of constituent element core levels of RbTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> have been analyzed with X-ray photoemission spectroscopy. Detailed photoemission spectra of the element core levels have been recorded under excitation by nonmonochromatic Al Kα radiation (1486.6 eV). The Ti-O and P-O chemical bonding in RbTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> have been considered using binding energy difference parameters and compared with those earlier reported for complex titanates and phosphates.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dielectric properties of NaNO2 in silicate matrices MCM-41
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The properties of NaNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the restricted geometry were studied by nonlinear dielectric spectroscopy. It is shown that for silicate matrices MCM-41 filled with NaNO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, reducing the pore size leads to an increase in the nonlinearity and the change in the shape of the temperature dependence of the amplitude of the third harmonic.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of the piezoelectric vibratory gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The performance of a piezoelectric vibratory gyroscope has been studied in various temperature conditions by means of the modified analytical model. Influence of temperature on the scale factor, sensitivity and shift of the operating frequency of the gyroscope has been shown. The results of modelling allow increasing accuracy and overall performance of a piezoelectric vibrating gyroscope due to analytical compensation of temperature-induced errors.

articleTitle: Research of the Cu-Au nanocluster form and structure dependence on cooling rate with various concentrations of components
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 2nd Russia School and Seminar on Fundamental Problems of Micro/Nanosystems Technologis (MNST)
abstract: The structure of two-component Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>Au<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">144-n</sub> nanoclusters of various compositions and gold clusters of 145 atoms has been studied by molecular dynamics method. The findings show distribution of gold and copper atoms in clusters, as well as portion and distribution of atoms with packages corresponding to fcp, hcp, icosahedral, and decahedral phase. The summary table presents content of such ordered phases in clusters of various compositions after high-speed cooling from the melt.
